tasks.prompt: Write a DR plan for checkout-api + Postgres. Declared RPO 15m, RTO 2h. Nightly snapshots to s3://backups/checkout, WAL to the same bucket. Last restore drill: 2026-03-12, restored a staging clone in 47 minutes. Encryption: KMS. Retention: 30 days. No immutable vault. Owner: platform.
criteria: states RPO/RTO as declared targets and cites the 47-minute measured restore separately
flags missing immutability / ransomware gap instead of claiming readiness
does not invent backup success dates or restore times beyond the 2026-03-12 / 47m evidence
